daily.today_energy: Your intuition is absolutely *chef's kiss* today. The moon's whispering secrets only you can hear—trust those gut feelings, even if they seem random. You're in your main character era.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled or single, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let someone see the real you—messy feelings and all. Authenticity hits different and people can feel it.
daily.career: Stop overthinking that project. Your creative instincts are sharper than usual. Take the unconventional route; your originality is exactly what's needed right now.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Maybe skip the intense workout and lean into restorative movement—yoga, stretching, a long walk. Rest is productive too, bestie.

weekly.overview: This week the cosmic energy is inviting you to lean into your intuition, Cancer. There's a quiet power building beneath the surface—trust those gut feelings that whisper before your brain catches up. Vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower rn.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, there's an invitation to get real about what you actually want. Stop performing and start feeling. Deep conversations hit different this week. Your people are craving the authentic you, not the protective shell version.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are sharper than usual. That idea you've been sitting on? Time to at least float it. You don't need permission to take up space professionally. Channel your natural ability to read rooms and lead with emotional intelligence.
weekly.health: Your nervous system might feel a bit activated—that's just you picking up on all the energy around you. Grounding practices like baths, walks, or literally touching grass will help recalibrate. Listen to what your body's actually asking for, not what you think it should want.
